shared_elements: profile-facing figures (human in A, animals in B)
horizontal band of repeated pattern dividing the surface
small subsidiary figures/heads flanking the main field
justification: Both are tall upright carved slabs whose surfaces are organised into registers by a horizontal band of repeated pattern, with profile-oriented creatures and small disc motifs distributed across the field. But A is dominated by a single elaborately costumed standing human in profile flanked by an ordered column of square sign-blocks, rendered in dense, fine, ornamented line, whereas B shows sparse, broad, rounded animal reliefs with no script-like column and no dominant human figure — the compositional logic and carving manner are quite different.
